preConditions.onFailMessage: Non ho trovato il synonym AD4_ISTANZE
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count( distinct 1) FROM all_synonyms WHERE synonym_name = 'AD4_ISTANZE' and owner in ('PUBLIC',user)

changeSet.sql: update AD4_ISTANZE set VERSIONE = '@' || substr(VERSIONE,2) where ISTANZA = '${istanza}' and substr(VERSIONE,1,1) !='@'

changeSet.author: mturra

preConditions.onFailMessage: Non ho trovato il synonym AD4_ISTANZE o tabella ISTANZE
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(1) FROM all_synonyms WHERE synonym_name = 'AD4_ISTANZE' and owner in ('PUBLIC',user)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tables WHERE table_name = 'ISTANZE'

changeSet.sql: update ISTANZE set VERSIONE = '@' || substr(VERSIONE,2) where ISTANZA = '${istanza}' and not(substr(VERSIONE,1,1) ='@')
